Production fix shipped in Leg A: acquire_refresh_lock assigns the fd from
safe_open_lockfile FIRST and then wraps os.fdopen in a close-on-raise guard, so a
failing fdopen can no longer leak the already-verified fd. The prior one-expression
composition had no handle to close.

Leg B adds the discriminating regression pin at tests/test_step9c_baseline.py:5327-5355:
it records the real returned fd, forces os.fdopen to raise EMFILE after the real open,
asserts the raise propagates, and then requires fstat on the recorded fd to fail with
EBADF. Against the leaky composition that fstat would SUCCEED, so the test distinguishes
fixed from unfixed rather than passing either way. Run green by Claude inside the
196-test step9c suite; Codex verified the production cleanup and the pin by reading both.
